product_metadata.title: Set of 8 Refrigerator Organizer Bins, Plastic Pantry Organization and Storage with Handle, Plastic Food Storage Bins for Fridge, Garage, Cabinets, Pantry, BPA-Free
features: Neat and Orderly Storage: The clear storage bins are great for creating a clean and organized refrigerator or pantry. They are suitable for storing fruits, vegetables, meat, cheese, snacks, canned food, small toys, toiletries, and more. Keep your refrigerator, freezer, pantry neat and organized with these 4 plastic storage bins.

Portable & Stackable: Built-in side handles make it easier to carry and store items. Each bin could be piled up by raised feet. Therefore, create space-saving vertical storage; Stack these or use them side by side to create the storage solution that works best for you. Maximize storage space in refrigerator, freezer, cabinets, cupboards & pantry shelves.

8 pcs Fridge Organizer: The size of the storage bin is 12.5" L x 6.3" W x 3.5" H, suitable for storing fruits, vegetables, fruits, vegetables, meat, bottles, canned food, yoghurt, cheese, etc., and ideal for storing in the kitchen, bathroom, or desktop storage and drawer storage.

Durable Material: Made of high-quality BPA-free anti-drop plastic, not easy to break, food-safe, easy to care for, clean with mild soap water, do not place in dishwasher and microwave. They are designed with a practical handle and internal non-slip texture.
